author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Holliday (groin) not in lineup Sunday
desc: Jackson Holliday is not in the Orioles lineup on Sunday against the Dodgers.
impact: Holliday was removed from Saturday's game early with tightness in his groin. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Ekness (calf) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Marlins transferred Josh Ekness to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for Miami. Ekness is expected to remain sidelined for the next several weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Liam Hicks (back) placed on IL
desc: The Marlins placed Liam Hicks on the 10-day injured list with a low back strain.
impact: Hicks had been dealing with stiffness in his back. He will be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks. Brian Navarreto had his contract selected as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brian Navarreto has contract selected by Marlins
desc: The Marlins selected the contract of Brian Navarreto.
impact: Navarreto will add depth behind the plate for Miami with Liam Hicks placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Conine (hamstring) officially activated from 60-day IL
desc: The Marlins activated Griffin Conine from the 60-day injured list.
impact: Conine returns from a multi-month absence after undergoing left hamstring tendon surgery back in April.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trent Grisham (hamstring) working out on field Sunday
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Trent Grisham has been performing on-field agility exercises.
impact: Boone added that the team is discussing whether he will accompany them on their trip to Detroit and Boston. "We're really encouraged by how well he's doing," Boone said.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wilyer Abreu gets day off Sunday
desc: Wilyer Abreu is not in the Red Sox lineup for Sunday's series finale against the Mariners.
impact: It is scheduled off day for Abreu to end the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Grove activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rays activated RHP Michael Grove from the 60-dau injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Durham.
impact: Grove concluded his rehab assignment returning from shoulder surgery. He will remain in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Solak designated for assignment
desc: The Padres designated INF/OF Nick Solak for assignment.
impact: Solak loses his spot on the Padres 40-man roster. He is likely to clear waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miguel Andujar (hamstring) activated from IL
desc: The Padres activated DH Miguel Andujar from the 10-day injured list.
impact: Andujar returns from a multi-week absence due to a left hamstring strain. He is slashing .254/.288/.418 on the season with five home runs and 17 RBI.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof back in lineup Sunday
desc: Zack Gelof is back in the Athletics lineup on Sunday against the Angels.
impact: Gelof sat out Saturday after arriving to the field not feeling well. He returns to the lineup the next day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Scott Barlow designated for assignment
desc: The Athletics designated RHP Scott Barlow for assignment.
impact: Barlow loses his spot on the Athletics 40-man roster. He is likely to clear waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Severino transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Athletics transferred RHP Luis Severino to the 60-day injured list.
impact: Severino is scheduled to be re-evaluated in July. The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for the Athletics.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alika Williams optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned INF Alika Williams to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Williams will figure to see a more consistent role in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Krook has contract selected by Athletics
desc: The Athletics selected the contract of LHP Matt Krook from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Krook will add a fresh arm in the Athletics bullpen. He'll hold a middle-relief role.
